edges.label: the office charged with counting the classification system, and therefore the boundary of the public map
edges.note: ISOO is housed at the National Archives and is responsible to the President for policy and oversight of the government-wide security classification system and the National Industrial Security Program, under Executive Orders 13526 and 13556. Where ISOO's annual reporting stops is where this domain's open-source organisational mapping has to switch to inference.

edges.note: ISOO is 'responsible to the President for policy and oversight of the Government-wide security classification system and the National Industrial Security Program'. A contractor-held program with no government sponsor of record would be visible, if anywhere, through NISP - and ISOO has never been directed at the UAP question.
